ضَرُوسٌ A she-camel of evil disposition, (S, K,) that bites her milker: (S, A, K:) or that has a habit of biting to defend her young one. (TA.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] حَرْبٌ ضَرُوسٌ (tropical:) Devouring, biting, war: (TA:) or vehement war. (Ham p. 87.) ＝
-A2- And A she-camel whose flow, or stream, of milk does not make any sound to be heard. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
